# Cldr Trans v1.1.3 - Table of Contents

> CLDR-based embedded translations for Ecto schemas

## Pages

- [Cldr Trans](https://ex-cldr-trans.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://ex-cldr-trans.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [Changelog](https://ex-cldr-trans.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Cldr.Trans](https://ex-cldr-trans.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Trans.md): Manage translations embedded into translation structs.
- [Cldr.Trans.QueryBuilder](https://ex-cldr-trans.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Trans.QueryBuilder.md): Provides helpers for filtering translations in `Ecto.Queries`.
- [Cldr.Trans.Translator](https://ex-cldr-trans.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Trans.Translator.md): Provides easy access to struct translations.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix cldr.trans.gen.translate_function](https://ex-cldr-trans.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Cldr.Trans.Gen.TranslateFunction.md): Generates a migration to add a database function
`translate_field` that uses the `Cldr.Trans` structured
translation schema to resolve a translation for a field.
